easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ingenious Artillerist to indefinitely gain all creature types including Pirate.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing damage to each opponent equal to the number of artifacts that entered.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers at least once.
Resolve an Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing damage to each opponent equal to the number of artifacts that triggered it.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.name: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
